待评价文本有五段。我们观察其结构：
第一段：讨论对抗防御的文献（PGD对抗训练等），然后说“In contrast, our paper does not aim to propose a new defense; instead, it provides a diagnostic tool...”。即第一段就提到了当前论文的贡献和定位。
第二段：讨论certified defenses，然后说“Our contribution differs from these works in that we do not seek to certify robustness... we introduce a label‑uncertainty‑aware concentration framework...”。第二段也提到了贡献。
第三段：讨论theoretical analyses，然后说“Our work builds directly on this line of research...”。第三段也提到贡献。
第四段：讨论empirical methods，然后说“By adapting the Mahloujifar estimator... we propose a novel algorithm...”。第四段也提到贡献。
第五段：说“Finally, prior works... Our results show that label information is essential... our contribution not only extends...”。第五段也是贡献。

但评分标准要求“Each paragraph (except final paragraph) should focus on summarizing and comparing prior research etc., without mentioning the current paper’s contributions or its position in the literature.
